notes.title: New secret areas! The whole game now in a number of other languages!
notes.content:
[h1]Join our Secret Area hunt 🔎[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/43011b1d416c2ea00a485537cd424fb570c63578.jpg[/img]
[h3]Ready for new content? Fantastic!
Because this year's [i][b]big Winter Update[/b][/i] is now live![/h3]

[h1]Secret Areas![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/7fd425aa0e877cb2bbfecd24395a7b9ab4b61a3b.jpg[/img]
[h3]All 24 levels available in Snowdriftland have new [b][i]Secret Areas[/i][/b] added to them - keep an eagle eye open for any suspicious additions! Walls, floors, bubbles, plants… anything is suspicious now![/h3]

[h1]A mysterious new level[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/10f302b050cf74a1c9ec4aff85b9cf3e7d9374ca.jpg[/img]
[h3]Glitch Pixels have invaded Snowdriftland?!
Find them in the various Secret Areas and unlock a level that will test your limits - and your ability to stomach ridiculous shenanigans![/h3]

[h1]More Languages[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/e8493de5d2144f49baf36930d835805e68960847.jpg[/img]
[h3]Have you ever wondered how many languages the Mini Prof can speak? Now you know!

Mission in Snowdriftland officially supports the following languages:
[i]German, French, Italian, Spanish[/i] and [i]Portuguese[/i].[/h3]

[h1]Not long until December 1st! Are you ready?[/h1]

notes.title: The Minibosses are unleashed!
notes.content:
[h1]The Minibosses are unleashed![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/8c319fa907f6563508d8fe2af6c22fcef9357115.jpg[/img]
[h2]Danger revealed:[/h2]
[h3]Compete against the new Minibosses standing in your way after each world.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/159a556bf5edea10761011e720aa88f73ad193b9.jpg[/img]


[h2]El Pix![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/75349a7fff9b6640a5cd162ab8205986ff272d7c.jpg[/img]
[h3]From old to new: See El Pix in a new and more menacing light![/h3]


[h2]Graphical Updates[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/db91216f0c0152ed904699afd04631c24479a72e.jpg[/img]
[h3]No stone unturned:[/h3]
Even the name giving snowdrifts have finally found their way into Snowdriftland, as well as other upgraded decorations like snow cacti, bushes, crystals... Chubbo... Each area has something new to offer!
 
[h3]From the ground up:[/h3]
The backgrounds now have more depth and detail: Giant ice floes rise into the sky, trees are ripped out of the ground and massive stalactites grow from cave ceilings!

[h3]How effective:[/h3]
Watch out! New environmental effects have been added to the stages - like snowfall and fog. If you're lucky and pay attention you might be able to wish upon a star...


[h2]Additional Patchnotes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chubby and his opponents enjoyed a proper clean up and have updated sprites.
[*] Level 1 has been adjusted to better fit a rising difficulty curve.
[*] The snowcrawler is also rocking a new snowy look.
[*] Confused about what Level you're in? New Intros and UI Elements show you where you are at any time!
[*] The graphics and the animation for the chest have been improved.
[*] The amount of hearts that appear in Boss stages now depend on how many Bonus Containers you have collected.
[*] You now collect hearts only when necessary.
[*] Map paths have been optimized.
[*] Enjoy new music inside the Base and the Backer's Lounge
[/list]

[h2]What's this...[/h2]
In the meantime the science team will get back to inspecting another point of interest... Maybe they'll be able to unveil the one or other... never before found... excellently hidden... Secret area?! Stay tuned for more next year!


[h2]And since it's the perfect opportunity:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/3f73647735025dc514d6b28a8217ebbc939f4776.jpg[/img]
Remember that you can prepare Mission in Snowdriftland as a present on Steam now and set a date so a lucky recipient can receive it on December 1st!

notes.title: More help for beginners and implementation of the backers lounge
notes.content:
[h1][b]Do you know how to high jump?[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/a4a582e16ac4769f7c8cad322706eed8a6479f52.jpg[/img]

If your answer is yes, you are as cool as a snowman. If not, the new explanation of high jumps will help you to master the game better. You will encounter the new Pinku dummy in World 1 - Level 2, helping you to understand the function of high jumps.

[h1][b]World 1 is hard. We know.[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/44d6af7b1f49311e95951532690aa73ff06e2b0c.gif[/img]

But never say die! New breakable floes on some tricky spots will help Chubby to avoid unwanted contact with ice cold water. Avoid staying on these fragile platforms for too long as they will fall apart after a few seconds.

Have fun with these new additions, they will help your survival in Snowdriftland!

[h1][b]You supported our Kickstarter? Then find your well deserved spot in Snowdriftland![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/7e804d55aea2cfed46efd7a5f012d53dfa950f7c.jpg[/img]

Check out the base on the map and enter the door next to Prof. Schwabbel. There you will find the backers lounge - a place where NPC's can chill, chat and do some gym time... and of course showcasing the tributes for all Kickstarter backers, who claimed this reward.

notes.title: Pinkumom getting mad and no one can do anything about it.
notes.content:
[h2]Pinkumom[/h2]
We always wanted to make [i]Pinkumom[/i] stronger, giving her the unpredictability of a mother protecting her offspring. In this update she finally received the deserved behaviour pattern. Prepare, because now [i]Pinkumom[/i] will be invincible! Say goodbye to the days where you could eliminate her simply with one jump on her head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/0e180e3aee5ead8eff86778aee05fdbd1e3379e5.jpg[/img]

Even if you don't plan to attack her, be careful! [i]Pinkumom[/i] is triggered already when you're coming close to her.

[h2]Signs[/h2]
With this update we also wanted to make the start easier for new players. Now there are 2 new help signs adding to the Slide-Sign, which is already appearing in level 3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/5ec65ffe978b1c97b5e46e51ec6cbf117ce72c0e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Level 1:[/h3]
Correct direction sign: This sign explains how to gain better control over Chubby when you want jump accurately.

[h3]Level 2:[/h3]
High jump sign: One of the most important features to master difficult situations.

We hope this will help all players to enjoy [i]Mission in Snowdriftland[/i] even more, but don't forget:
[b]DON'T MESS WITH [i]PINKUMOM[/i]![/b]

notes.title: Content update: Bonus level!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/cae2d19712dc433e50e841d5a046a5887b248d96.jpg[/img]

You've completed all levels and collected already all of the 576 snowflakes? Then it's time for the next challenge! Get prepared for the largest and hardest level of all:

[h1]The Bonus Level[/h1]

It's huge, unforgiving and split in 4 sections, each of them recreating one of the main worlds. You can enter a new section only if you collect all 24 snowflakes of the previous one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729846/5e7043594fe5ebbd3e123cb3379c4cdc2078f95e.jpg[/img]

Be warned! The bonus level will try your patience and platformer skills sorely! :)


[h2][b]Patch notes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Bonus Level added
[*] Teaser on start screen showing upcoming content for 2022
[*] Chubby will high-bounce off enemies once the jump button/key is pressed and held
[*] Optimisation and several bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Mission in Snowdriftland - Snowlogue is available now!

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
This free Snowlogue version of Mission in Snowdriftland includes:
[list]
[*] 3 levels
[*] Retro music
[*] Pixel art as we all love it
[*] 60 fps support (and higher)
[*] Full gamepad support
[*] High resolution in full screen
[*] Speedrun timer 
[*] Achievements
[/list]

[b]Chubby is on his mission again...[i]what about you?[/i][/b]
